statement: At pinned Cemu 29f2f1f, MotionPlusData is held in an optional separate from m_extension; m_extension's declared variant alternatives are monostate, NunchuckData and ClassicData. The report-0x37 decoder includes a MotionPlusData visitor but visits m_extension, making this MotionPlusData branch unreachable for the declared variant. Its existence in source is not evidence of a runtime gyro decode. No conclusion is made about other versions, forked code, alternate APIs or physical Wii Remotes.

applicability.revision: Pinned consumer implementations in docs/wii-motionplus-consumer-comparison.md; no physical Wii Remote revision measured
